title: Odor Component of Cleaning Fees Assessed at a Moved-Down Level
content:
Reviewer training note — Cleaning and Damage Fees.

**Rule.** The odor component of a moved-down cleaning assessment is worked out by the incident category and the evidence on file: smoke or vape odor, which needs a whole-cabin odor treatment, takes the odor share of the flat fee of the level moved to; a food or drink spill, animal hair or mess or bodily fluids with at least one professional cleaning document on the assessment's evidence ledger takes the flat deodorizing charge; any other report, such as one of trash or debris or one cleaned without a professional cleaning document, takes no odor component.

The odor share is 20% of the flat fee of the level the report is moved to, and the flat deodorizing charge is $10.00. A professional cleaning document is a cleaning receipt submission on the assessment's evidence ledger.

## Input — judgement — output

| Input: incident category | Input: professional cleaning document on the evidence ledger | Odor component |
|---|---|---|
| smoke or vape odor | either | 20% of the flat fee of the level moved to |
| food or drink spill | at least one | $10.00 |
| animal hair or mess | at least one | $10.00 |
| bodily fluids | at least one | $10.00 |
| food or drink spill, animal hair or mess, or bodily fluids | none | none |
| trash or debris | either | none |

The odor component, whether the share or the fixed deodorizing charge, is added to the fee assessed at the moved-down level.

## The share by level moved to

| Level the report is moved to | Flat fee | Odor share (20%) |
|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | $25.00 | $5.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | $60.00 | $12.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | $100.00 | $20.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | $150.00 | $30.00 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- A smoke or vape odor report moved to Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant): the odor component is 20% of $100.00, that is $20.00, whatever the vehicle.
- A bodily fluids report whose evidence ledger carries one cleaning receipt submission: the odor component is $10.00, whatever the level or the vehicle.
- An animal hair or mess report with photos only on its evidence ledger: no odor component.
